title: The Witness

image.note: Original uploaded attachment verified as JPEG (1536x1536). The binary file itself is still awaiting repository upload.

description: A surreal conceptual artwork depicting a monumental human eye inside an ornate golden frame, supported by human legs in an empty, desolate landscape beneath a muted sky.
description_fa: اثری مفهومی و سوررئال از چشمی بزرگ درون قابی طلایی و آراسته که بر دو پای انسانی در دشتی خالی و متروک ایستاده است.

publication.note: Preparation is approved. Minting and listing remain pending creator wallet connection, creator signature, and marketplace finalization.

rights_confirmation.scope: Creator confirmed they created the artwork or hold permission to use and sell it as an NFT.

presentation.tagline: A silent witness to an empty world.
presentation.sales_description: A monumental eye inhabits an ornate golden frame, standing on human legs in a vast, barren landscape. The work explores observation, isolation, and the uneasy boundary between the human body and the image.
presentation.sales_description_fa: چشمی عظیم در قاب طلایی آراسته، بر دو پای انسانی در دشتی بی‌انتها ایستاده است؛ اثری درباره نگاه، تنهایی و مرز ناآرام میان بدن انسان و تصویر.
